register.labelZh: ARGUE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: argue somebody into something 表示用理由說服某人接受或做某事;argue somebody out ofsomething 則表示說服某人放棄或不要做某事。；argue something out 可以表示人們逐點討論問題,直至作出決定或解決分歧。；you cannot argue with that 和 the facts are hard to argue with 等表達,表示證據或結果十分清楚。；這些表達可以描述說服、充分討論和接受明顯事實,而不只是憤怒地爭論。
register.summaryEn: Argue somebody into something shows that reasons persuade a person to accept or do something. Argue somebody out of something shows the opposite direction. Argue something out helps you describe people examining every part of a problem until they reach a decision or settle their differences. Expressions such as you cannot argue with that and the facts are hard to argue with show that the evidence or result is very clear. These expressions can describe persuasion, careful discussion and acceptance of clear facts—not only angry disagreement.
